about: What the game reads after start-up and before a battle: recorded with play.html?traceReads=1 through title, main menu (with its music), VS COM and character select (frames 100-1700), plus the start and the end of the opening movie, and the jingle that plays over every battle's loading screen (10.p at 77135872: the main thread waits for it in the frame that cuts to that screen). The entries marked desktop are not fetched on phones: every character's pictures for character select (the SEL_* entries, all colours: 28 MB in one stretch of 00.p and a little of 00ft.p and 07.p, so that moving the cursor over the roster never waits for a download), and the first 256 KiB of each stage's music (what the game waits for as a battle begins; the rest of a track arrives behind it): 22 tracks. Offsets are in the original files; a negative offset counts from the end. Loaded in this order by lib/prefetch.js. The rest is fetched when the game shows that it is about to be needed (play.js musicAhead), also where the list above is not loaded (data saver): rules: when the game reads `after`, fetch `then` (entering character select, whose music is 10.p at 77922304, means a battle and its loading jingle are near); stageMusic: the offset in react/02.p at which a stage's data starts, and where that stage's music starts, recorded from scripted matches on 17 stages (the page learns the others as they are played).
